attempts.query: Tavelo Grow frame weight by size
attempts.note: The official table maps 830/845/860/880/895/960 g ±25 g raw weights to XS/S/M/L/XL/XXL and lists a 460 g raw fork.

notes: The catalog retains the complete per-size map instead of treating the 830 g XS value as universal.

resolution.note: Current manufacturer series is XS–XXL: 830/845/860/880/895/960 g ±25 g; these are raw-frame claims, not complete-bike weight. Fork/seatpost claims remain separate components. Reopen trigger: Reopen if the frame generation, size series or published weight basis changes.
